messages.subject: adjusting lables
parts:
Hey guys,
 I have a question here for regarding manipulating legends .
 I will show what I am trying to do ..

library(ggplot2)
timings <- c(4.50,6.50,4.41,5.59,3)
data <- data.frame(Period=rep(1,5),MarketsOpen=c("r1","US","r2",
                                     "India","r3"),value=timings)
data$MarketsOpen <- factor(data$MarketsOpen,levels=c("r1","US","r2",
                                    "India","r3"))
a <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Period, y = value,
                      fill = MarketsOpen)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "black","white",
                      "gray","white")) + 
  coord_polar(theta = "y")+
  ##theme_bw()+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=0:23,labels=as.character(0:23))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=100)+
  opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(),
       axis.title.y = theme_blank(),
       axis.text.y = theme_blank(),
       title="GMT 24 hrs clock")##,
##       legend.position="none")
  

Now my problem is with the legends. As you can understand from the plot I want to keep only
US and India in the legend and remove r1, r2, r3 .Is there any way to do it ?? 

Regards
Sayan Dasgupta
New Delhi
India .

Hi Sayan,

You can use the breaks argument of scale_fill_manual.

Hadley
